name: White Cheddar & Broccolini Soup
whyItWorks: Pureeing cooked broccolini into a rich aged white cheddar soup breaks down the fibrous stalks into a smooth, comforting bowl.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm with a soft dinner roll (skip any whole floret garnish if flaring and take a Lactaid enzyme for the cream base).
watchOuts: Cruciferous vegetable gas if sensitive to blended broccoli
